+"""Generate a replayable, three-stroke calligraphy trajectory for target.png."""

+PAPER_Y_LEFT = 0.227185 / 2
+PAPER_Z = 0.020
+DOWN_MM = 0.001
+
+
+def catmull_rom(points, per_segment=32):
+    """Dense Catmull-Rom curve through image-coordinate control points."""
+    p = np.asarray(points, dtype=np.float64)
+    out = []
+    for i in range(len(p) - 1):
+        p0 = p[max(0, i - 1)]
+        p1 = p[i]
+        p2 = p[i + 1]
+        p3 = p[min(len(p) - 1, i + 2)]
+        for t in np.linspace(0.0, 1.0, per_segment, endpoint=False):
+            t2, t3 = t * t, t * t * t
+            v = 0.5 * ((2 * p1) + (-p0 + p2) * t + (2*p0 - 5*p1 + 4*p2 - p3)*t2 + (-p0 + 3*p1 - 3*p2 + p3)*t3)
+            out.append(v)
+    out.append(p[-1])
+    return np.asarray(out)
+
+
+def resample_path(path_px, step_px=2.25):
+    ds = np.linalg.norm(np.diff(path_px, axis=0), axis=1)
+    c = np.r_[0.0, np.cumsum(ds)]
+    n = max(2, int(math.ceil(c[-1] / step_px)) + 1)
+    q = np.linspace(0.0, c[-1], n)
+    return np.column_stack([np.interp(q, c, path_px[:, j]) for j in range(2)])
+
+
+def px_to_world(uv):
+    u, v = uv
+    x = PAPER_X_FAR - (v + 0.5) * PX_M
+    y = PAPER_Y_LEFT - (u + 0.5) * PX_M
+    return np.array([x, y], dtype=np.float64)
+
+
+def pressure_at(t, knots):
+    return float(np.interp(t, [k[0] for k in knots], [k[1] for k in knots]))
+
+
+def move_tip(s, goal, speed=0.04, settle=2):
+    return s.primitives()["move_tip"](goal, speed=speed, settle=settle)
+
+
+def dip(s):
+    """Reload and restore the hairs in the ink stone."""
+    move_tip(s, [-0.100, 0.150, 0.060], speed=0.05, settle=1)
+    move_tip(s, [-0.100, 0.150, 0.0255], speed=0.015, settle=10)
+    move_tip(s, [-0.100, 0.150, 0.070], speed=0.03, settle=2)
+
+
+def draw_stroke(s, points, pressure_knots, speed_mps=0.010, step_px=2.25):
+    """Follow one center path; pressure_knots map normalized path length to press depth in mm."""
+    dense = catmull_rom(points)
